If you give your child pocket money on a weekly basis, this app will help them learn to save.

The app also helps form a good habit of logging incomes and outcomes. Every time the child receives pocket money or spends some, they open the app and input how much money they received or spent. After doing that, they see an updated progress towards their saving goal.

The goal can be adjusted any time: may be the price of the thing they want has changed or you opted to start giving them a different amount of money every week. May the kid just changed their mind, that's totally fine.

Finally, when the child has saved enough to buy what they wanted, the app congratulates them with their achievement and offers to set up a new goal.

Help you child setting up their goal for the first time and encourage them to save by offering them a piggy bank or something similar.
